crates.name: rullst-macros
crates.finding: Dedicated bounded-contract documentation and real negative UI diagnostics cover malformed HTML, role identity, Billable shapes and compatibility macros; experimental browser/runtime integration remains narrower than the compile-time surface.

crates.name: rullst-orm-macros
crates.finding: Dedicated derive-boundary documentation and parser-driven compile failures cover backend, tenant, encrypted-field and Turso relation misuse; runtime protocol semantics remain evidence owned by rullst-orm.

crates.name: rullst-orm
crates.finding: Deep relational, tenant-bound audit/revision and capability-specific persistence evidence; uniform cross-store semantics, disaster-recovery proof and several operational integrations intentionally remain incomplete.

crates.name: rullst-core
crates.finding: Mature bounded runtime with broad negative/live evidence; distributed deployment and application authorization remain explicit host boundaries.

crates.name: rullst-messaging
crates.finding: Clear bounded concurrent contract plus durable local SQLite restart/corruption evidence; remote protocols, replication, encrypted-at-rest operations and provider fault matrices remain open.

crates.name: rullst-connect
crates.finding: Substantial OAuth/OIDC protocol and negative evidence plus bounded provider/account-bound encrypted refresh snapshots; durable transactions, key operations, distributed refresh and formal provider conformance remain external/application work.

crates.name: rullst-iot
crates.finding: The no_std surface now includes typed bounded MQTT 5 PUBLISH and CoAP request encoders plus a signed-manifest gate with an explicit durable monotonic-CAS adapter; deterministic protocol vectors and OTA restart/failure evidence do not replace concrete transport, hardware storage, flashing, bootloader or device fault-injection.

crates.name: rullst-security
crates.finding: Broad bounded defense-in-depth plus a synchronized local SIEM spool with restart, quota, corruption and external-change evidence; no external SIEM delivery, universal OWASP coverage, audit or certification is implied.

crates.name: rullst-ai
crates.finding: Strong guarded/offline/provider boundaries plus bounded synchronous local RAG/tool audit with restart, tamper, quota and concurrency evidence; streaming/cancellation, live adaptive evals, distributed authenticated audit delivery, durable provider loops and broad external retrievers remain partial.

crates.name: rullst-capital
crates.finding: Well-bounded payments, quotas and fiscal preparation; gateway parity, live fiscal authorization and homologation are intentionally unproven.

crates.name: rullst-mail
crates.finding: Good transport, preflight, bounded attachment and queue contracts; provider acceptance, inbox delivery, opaque-file inspection and distributed breaker operations remain open.

crates.name: rullst-auth
crates.finding: Strong password/session/RBAC/JWT primitives; WebAuthn conformance and shared durable revocation/device operations are not complete.

crates.name: rullst-nexus
crates.finding: Fail-closed admin foundation with generated CRUD tests; tenant policy, durable audit and broader production admin operations remain host work.

crates.name: rullst-studio
crates.finding: Real local telemetry and guarded data tooling are well tested; distributed observability and several remote inspectors remain incomplete.

crates.name: rullst
crates.finding: All 41 public umbrella features have isolated compile boundaries with automatic manifest-drift detection, and the packaged-distribution consumer derives the complete extracted feature set instead of maintaining a partial allowlist; release confidence still inherits the bounded maturity of opt-in domain capabilities.

crates.name: cargo-rullst
crates.finding: Broad generator and upgrade verification; not every generated blueprint/provider combination yet has a full compile/runtime matrix.
